# Cal-AgentKit

> Agent execution and trust infrastructure for Stellar.

Cal-AgentKit provides the primitives developers need to build governed AI agents on
Stellar: agent wallets, x402 payments, MPP-ready discovery metadata, Soroban
policy controls, on-chain reputation, verifiable outputs, and MCP tooling.

## Developer Entry Points

- `/api/agents` - discover agent manifests by capability, payment protocol,
  asset, network, and reputation.
- `/agents` - visual agent registry.
- `/receipts` - visual index of verifiable run receipts.
- `/receipts/:id` - public proof page for one Cal-AgentKit run.
- `@calagent/agent-kit` - SDK for governed Stellar agents.
- `calagent-mcp-stellar` - MCP server for Stellar agent discovery.
- Shield Contract - Soroban spend policy enforcement.
- Identity Registry - on-chain agent identity and reputation.

## Keywords

Stellar agents, Stellar agent infrastructure, Soroban agents, x402 payments,
MPP, MCP Stellar, AI agent wallets, agent discovery, on-chain reputation,
verifiable agent execution.
